Update an agent flow.

The API accepts either a pure rename (--name alone) or a full graph
replace (--file, or --description together with a graph) — mixing
--description with --name but no graph is rejected by the server with a
clear 400. Pass --file for any change beyond a plain rename.

Usage:
  plivo agents update <agent_id> [flags]

Examples:
  plivo agents update abc123 --name "New Name"
  plivo agents update abc123 --file flow.json

Flags:
      --description string   new description (must be paired with --file — see above)
      --file string          JSON file with the full flow graph ({name, description, nodes, connections}); flags win over its fields
  -h, --help                 help for update
      --name string          rename the agent

Global Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
